title: ammophila × baltica
intro: Ammophila × baltica, commonly known as Baltic sandwort, is a hybrid plant species that belongs to the family Caryophyllaceae. It is known for its potential health benefits, which include antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial properties, making it a valuable resource for traditional medicine. The therapeutic actions of Baltic sandwort include wound healing, antiseptic, and anti-edematous effects, which can be attributed to its bioactive constituents such as flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids. The plant's bioactive compounds have been shown to exhibit antioxidant activity, reducing oxidative stress and promoting overall health.
